name: Emmanuel Macron
summary: Centrist, pro-European liberal who describes his politics as going beyond left and right: market-oriented economic reforms (wealth-tax overhaul, labour and pension reforms) alongside a defended social model. He pursues deeper EU integration and sovereignty, strong defence and nuclear deterrence, nuclear energy expansion, a firm line on Islamist separatism within laïcité, and socially liberal measures such as abortion in the Constitution and an aid-in-dying law.

sources.title: Political positions of Emmanuel Macron
sources.author: Wikipedia
sources.usedFor: Interview quotes on same-sex marriage, headscarf, encryption, gender recognition

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Replaced the wealth tax (ISF) with a tax on real-estate wealth only, saying the tax on capital reinvested in firms was absurd; in 2020 he ruled out raising income tax on top earners.

cut-welfare.rationale: Rejected the rhetoric of 'assisted' profiteers, raised disability allowance and launched an anti-poverty strategy to merge and extend benefits, not cut them.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Stressed the intelligence services' role and the counter-terrorism laws passed at the start of his term; endorsed government access to encrypted communications.

empower-police-military.rationale: Signed and defends the 2024-2030 military programming law doubling the armed forces' budget in ten years; promoted police body cameras.

decide-locally.rationale: Proposed more territorial devolution and autonomy for Corsica and New Caledonia.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Said in a 2017 interview that the 2013 marriage law was desirable and necessary.

abortion-legal.rationale: Announced in 2023 and drove the 2024 amendment enshrining the freedom to abortion in the Constitution.

reduce-immigration.rationale: Tougher asylum and returns and conditionality of aid, but also easing regularisation for shortage trades and welcoming refugees.

free-trade.rationale: Backed CETA but repeatedly says Europe has been naive and needs reciprocity and protection.

nation-first.rationale: Said the path of national retreat cannot assure the future; the only way is a stronger Europe.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Urged military intervention in Syria during the 2017 campaign.

open-borders.rationale: Said there is no sovereignty without borders; supports systematic screening at EU external borders.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Backed ambitious climate goals (carbon neutrality 2050), a constitutional climate reference and the Paris agreement; the energy plan is built on decarbonisation.

expand-nuclear.rationale: Announced in 2022 at Belfort a programme of six new EPR2 reactors with studies for eight more, and life extension of existing reactors.

basic-income.rationale: Said he never believed in a universal income without activity conditions, since it relegates people to poverty.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Called for fair protection of European producers (carbon border tax, anti-subsidy trade defence, European preference in defence) to avoid deindustrialisation; framed at EU level.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Launched France 2030 and the state-led nuclear and renewables programme; called for massive European investment programmes and a European preference in strategic sectors.

direct-votes.rationale: Proposed in 2023 broadening and relaxing referendums; still favours representative government.

separate-church-state.rationale: Defines laïcité as the neutrality of the state and freedom to believe or not, not the erasure of religions from public space.

unbreakable-encryption.rationale: Endorsed proposals to oblige internet companies to give the government access to encrypted communications.

results-over-ideology.rationale: Claims political overcoming (dépassement), citing that citizens want care and recovery that work and are fair, not left or right.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Said Israel has the right, like every people, to live free of the threat of annihilation, and backs a demilitarised Palestinian state that recognises Israel.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Mixed record: large Covid support and common EU borrowing, but also stated aims of cutting deficits and meeting EU fiscal rules.

work-for-welfare.rationale: Said the universal activity income carries duties: beneficiaries must register in an integration path and may not refuse more than two reasonable job offers.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: His energy strategy aims at decarbonised power (nuclear, renewables) and a 40% cut in energy consumption by 2050.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: Insists that everyone find their place whatever skin colour, origin or religion and fights discrimination.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: Called for a sovereign, united, democratic Europe and deeper integration; rejects national withdrawal.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Keeps France in NATO and builds its European pillar.

rich-countries-aid-poor.rationale: Said France increased development aid and meets its commitments, while conditioning aid on migration cooperation.

independent-nuclear-deterrent.rationale: Said nuclear deterrence is at the heart of French defence strategy.

subordinate-church-to-state.rationale: Mureaux plan ended foreign-seconded imams and tightened control of worship associations' finance, but he stressed that laïcité is not the erasure of religion.

women-must-cover.rationale: No stated position on a legal covering requirement; criticising bus staff who refused women over their dress is something nearby.

common-currency.rationale: Wants the euro zone as the core of Europe's economic power, with its own budget; calls the euro a common good that Europe created.

trade-labor-env-standards.rationale: Criticised a naive trade policy while Europe holds the strictest environmental and social norms; withheld Mercosur ratification pending Brazilian environmental commitments.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: His pension reform plan created a single points-based state-managed pay-as-you-go system, and he raised the retirement age rather than shifting to individual accounts.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: Announced tighter controls on funding of places of worship and an end to foreign-seconded imams; not about NGOs, media or universities.

holocaust-denial.rationale: Stated that France organised the Vel d'Hiv roundup.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: Supports same-sex marriage and assisted reproduction for lesbian couples.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Supported easier legal gender change in 2022 but in 2024 mocked proposals to change gender at the town hall.

assisted-dying.rationale: Committed in 2022 to legislate, convened the citizens' convention, launched the bill allowing aid in dying for adults with serious incurable illness, and welcomed the 2026 law's validation by the Constitutional Council.

left-right-obsolete.rationale: Says he stands for political overcoming, picking the best from left and right in his government.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Said the struggle is against Islamist separatism, never against Islam, and aims for an Islam fully compatible with Republic values.

religious-dress-in-state.rationale: Announced extending the neutrality obligation to employees of firms delegated public services; in 2016 opposed new laws to hunt veils at universities.

social-market-economy.rationale: Defends France's social model as a strength while pursuing market-oriented reforms; invokes competition that stimulates, cooperation that strengthens and solidarity that unites.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Drove the military programming law doubling the defence budget and calls for a European war economy.

citizens-assembly.rationale: Convened the citizens' climate and end-of-life conventions and proposed democratic conventions across the EU.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Designated 24 April as a national day of remembrance of the Armenian genocide in 2019.

pollution-taxes.rationale: Called for a significant minimum carbon price in the EU and a carbon border tax.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: Calls for reform of the international financial architecture with fairer rules that account for emerging economies, while consolidating the existing order.

keep-nuclear-weapons.rationale: Said nuclear deterrence is central to French defence and an element of European defence.

financial-transactions-tax.rationale: Proposed relaunching a European financial transactions tax in 2017 and listed it as an EU own resource in 2024.

notes: Not retrieved: 'Révolution' (2016), 2017/2022 programmes, 2017/2022 debate transcripts, Economist 'brain death' interview (403), Palestine UNGA speech full text and the 2023 pension address (elysee URLs not found); so pension reform, 2018 fuel tax, labour law and Ukraine ground-troop statements are not used as answers except where noted. Pension reform to 64 is documented only via Wikipedia and no statement asks about it. Views changed: nuclear (2017 aim to cut share to 50% vs 2022 new reactors; latest used); end of life (2023 'personal opinion may evolve' then committed to legislation).
